findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name File read vulnerabilities in certifi
 * @description Detects potential file read vulnerabilities in certifi package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/file-read-vulnerability
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Look for file operations with certificate files
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall()
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("io").getMember("open").getACall()
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getMember("open").getACall()
select call, "File open operation that could be vulnerable to path traversal if user-controlled input is used"
findings.hypothesis: File read vulnerabilities in certifi package when handling certificate files
